items.title: [Highlight] SGA completely fakes out Jalen Slawson and hits the step-through layup
items.author: catreyka

items.title: Jalen Slawson had a great rep against J-Dub earlier this quarter but just absolutely flew past SGA trying to block his shot. Slawson is active but very jumpy. SGA scored. 33-25 Pacers after one quarter.

items.title: Obi Toppin was warming up, then Rick Carlisle walked over and said something to him and he went back to the locker room. Carlisle then chatted with Jalen Slawson, who removed his wamrups. Looks like it will be no more starters + Toppin. Slawson-Sheppard-Walker-QJackson-Huff now.
